objective: Validate API portability on fixed development questions; submit Codex full-run results under their actual configuration.

generation.provider: OpenAI standard, confirmed by receipt before continuing

stages.name: transport_smoke
pass: Both requests use intended model/provider/verbosity and return accountable costs.
Across the two questions observe at least one native search/read call, matching function_call_output, and a final answer with sources.
No native built-in tool, wrong provider, missing usage/cost, malformed output or unexplained charge.
Observe at least one nonempty reasoning.encrypted_content item returned under include=[reasoning.encrypted_content].
Verify the next actually sent request preserves every reasoning item from that response, including encrypted_content, unchanged alongside native calls and their outputs.
That continuation completes with the intended provider/model, no rejected/dropped-field warning, and recorded usage/cost. HTTP success alone does not establish the model used every reasoning item.

request_checks: no reasoning exclusion or context truncation
reasoning.context=all_turns explicitly; reject unsupported-field fallback rather than silently dropping it
reasoning_roundtrip.do_not_publish: encrypted payloads or raw authentication headers; retain any necessary raw payload locally only
reasoning_roundtrip.if_missing_or_rejected: Stop as compatibility unverified; do not drop reasoning, switch providers, or claim inference continuity to get through the test.
reasoning_roundtrip.claim_boundary: Client preserved items and provider accepted continuation; does not prove hidden upstream handling or semantic use.

cache_validation.record: cached input tokens, cache writes, actual cost and hit ratio
cache_validation.gate: Cache hit is neither necessary nor sufficient for reasoning replay success. Zero hits trigger cost reassessment, not an automatic protocol failure.

stages.name: migration_screen
pass: All 30 slots accounted for and judged; failures count wrong.
At least 29 finished; no repeated same-class protocol/tool-mapping/provider fault.
Correct >= baseline_correct - 3; this is a screening threshold, not a non-inferiority test.
stages.interpretation: Compares complete configurations; changed runtime, native tools, prompt wrapper and stopping budget are confounded.

stages.name: fixed_evidence_verbosity
stages.evidence: Only original Codex A search/read text actually observed, merged overlapping/adjacent offsets; preserve first document order; no gold selection, prior answer or prior reasoning.
stages.only_treatment: text.verbosity low vs high; both arms use max_output_tokens=32768 and identical question/evidence/instructions/model/provider/effort/format
stages.directional_gate: Consider high worth further study only if net correct >= 1 with completeness not lower, or correctness not lower and macro fact support increases >= 0.03. No automatic promotion or full run.
stages.interpretation: Answer-only diagnostic; not full-agent accuracy or proof of the effect on retrieval.
stages.output_limit_policy: The cap includes reasoning and visible output. Preserve and report incomplete_details and per-arm cap/timeout hit counts; do not present censored failures as proof high verbosity harms answer quality. No selective cap increases or answer regeneration.

budget.cost_authority: OpenRouter settled per-generation cost and dedicated-key lifetime usage; count every attempt, including failed/timed-out requests if charged.
budget.unknown_cost_policy: Pause before another paid request until cost is reconciled; no blind retry.
budget.reserve_basis: Worst planned output cap is stage2 32768. At current standard prices, max input 922000 at long-context cache-write $5/M plus 32768 output at $15/M = $5.10152. Reserve $6, stop new requests at $14, retain $20 lifetime key cap; recheck rates and limits before live.

price_snapshot.note: Sensitivity estimate only; open budget and native API may change usage. No Flex/Batch savings assumed.

judging.blind_to: group labels, other arm answer, model/provider/verbosity metadata
judging.if_subscription_exhausted: wait; do not buy/reset or switch judge automatically

failures.generation_retry: No automatic retries; preserve terminal outcome and denominator. A pre-output transport outage may be resumed only under a recorded same-config recovery decision after cost reconciliation.
failures.source_bug_after_start: stop; version any repair; keep old artifacts; do not silently replace sample or successful answers
failures.stage_not_completed: report incomplete and stop; do not replace missing IDs

verbosity: incomplete_details and output-cap hits by arm
reasoning tokens and visible-answer length separately
reporting.uncertainty: paired bootstrap 10000 resamples seed 20261017, within fixed sample; does not prove equivalence or unseen generalization
reporting.allowed_claim: API backend works on this fixed development sample; report observed differences.
forbidden_claims: API reproduced the full Codex score
API has no degradation in general
native tools alone caused the difference
local judge score is an official leaderboard score

live_prerequisites: Create/authorize experiment-only key with $20 TOTAL limit; store locally without putting it in chat or repository.
Implement/verify request price and output bounds, sequential cost reconciliation and $14 stop in dedicated runner; current generic benchmark CLI alone is insufficient.
Confirm OpenRouter Responses route honors provider filtering, verbosity, structured answers, native tools and encrypted reasoning in stage0.
Freeze the actual executable configuration before stage0; explicitly use low regardless of current workspace defaults.

official_submission.main_result_backend: Codex SDK, actual frozen runtime and budgets disclosed
official_submission.browsecomp: Old 93.01% scored run and new ungraded 830 run remain separate; never select individual best answers across versions.

revision.reason: User correction before any paid run: compare low/high, use 32K output for both fixed-evidence arms, and explicitly check encrypted reasoning round-trip.
